arxiv-2102-04997.title: Deep Neural Network based Cough Detection using Bed-mounted Accelerometer Measurements
arxiv-2102-04997.creator: Madhurananda Pahar \sthanks We would like to thank the South African Centre for High Performance Computing (CHPC) for providing computational resources on their Lengau cluster for this research, Igor Miranda, Andreas Diacon, Thomas Niesler
arxiv-2102-04997.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Madhurananda Pahar \sthanks We would like to thank the South African Centre for High Performance Computing (CHPC) for providing computational resources on their Lengau cluster for this research, Igor Miranda, Andreas Diacon, Thomas Niesler. We have performed cough detection based on measurements from an accelerometer attached to the patient’s bed. This form of monitoring is less intrusive than body-attached accelerometer sensors, and sidesteps privacy concerns encountered when using audio for cough detection.

arxiv-2108-11078.title: Semiclassical analysis and the Agmon-Finsler metric for discrete Schrödinger operators
arxiv-2108-11078.creator: Kentaro Kameoka
arxiv-2108-11078.description: Abstract The Agmon estimate for multi-dimensional discrete Schrödinger operators is studied with emphasis on the microlocal analysis on the torus. We first consider the semiclassical setting where semiclassical continuous Schrödinger operators are discretized with the mesh width proportional to the semiclassical parameter.

arxiv-2201-12176.title: Generative Coarse-Graining of Molecular Conformations
arxiv-2201-12176.creator: Wujie Wang, Minkai Xu, Chen Cai, Benjamin Kurt Miller, Tess Smidt, Yusu Wang, Jian Tang, Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli
arxiv-2201-12176.description: Abstract Coarse-graining (CG) of molecular simulations simplifies the particle representation by grouping selected atoms into pseudo-beads and drastically accelerates simulation. However, such CG procedure induces information losses, which makes accurate backmapping, i.e., restoring fine-grained (FG) coordinates from CG coordinates, a long-standing challenge.

arxiv-2202-08288.title: Elements of Celestial Conformal Field Theory
arxiv-2202-08288.creator: Wei Fan 1 , Angelos Fotopoulos 2 , Stephan Stieberger 3 , Tomasz R. Taylor 2 , Bin Zhu 2 1 Department of Physics, School of Science, Jiangsu University of Science and Technology, Zhenjiang, 212003, China 2 Department of Physics Northeastern University, Boston, MA 02115, USA 3 Max–Planck–Institut für
arxiv-2202-08288.description: Abstract In celestial holography, four-dimensional scattering amplitudes are considered as two-dimensional conformal correlators of a putative two-dimensional celestial conformal field theory (CCFT). The simplest way of converting momentum space amplitudes into CCFT correlators is by taking their Mellin transforms with respect to light-cone energies.

arxiv-2208-01627.title: XMM-Newton and NuSTAR Observations of an Optically Quiescent Quasar Facilities: XMM-Newton , NuSTAR , SDSS, WISE astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , xspec ( Arnaud 1996 ) , corner ( Foreman-Mackey 2016 ) , BXA ( Buchner et al. 2014 ) , UltraNest ( Buch
arxiv-2208-01627.creator: Claire Greenwell, Poshak Gandhi, George Lansbury, Peter Boorman, Vincenzo Mainieri, Daniel Stern
arxiv-2208-01627.description: Abstract Optically quiescent quasars (OQQs) represent a recently systematised class of infrared-luminous active galactic nuclei (AGN) which have galaxy-like optical continua. They may represent an interesting, brief phase in the AGN life cycle, e.g. either cocooned within high-covering-factor media or indicative of recent triggering, though their nature remains unclear.

arxiv-2302-03433.title: Equivalency of the Corona problem and Gleason’s problem in the theory of SCV
arxiv-2302-03433.creator: S. R. PATEL
arxiv-2302-03433.description: Abstract 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification: Primary: 46J05; Secondary: 32A17, 32A38 46E25, 46J10, 46J20 Keywords: Corona problem, Gleason’s problem, locally Stein-Banach algebras, Gel’fand theory, finitely generated maximal ideal, Lipschitz holomorphic functions, Gleason A -property Abstract. We establish an equivalency of the Corona problem (1962) and Gleason’s problem (1964) in the theory of several complex variables.

arxiv-2309-06932.title: EPOCHS VIII. An Insight into MIRI-selected Galaxies in SMACS-0723 and the Benefits of Deep MIRI Photometry in Revealing AGN and the Dusty Universe 2023 EPOCHS VIII. An Insight into MIRI-selected Galaxies in SMACS-0723 and the Benefits of Deep MIRI Photometry in Revealing AGN and the Dusty Universe –
arxiv-2309-06932.creator: Qiong Li, Christopher J. Conselice, Nathan Adams, James A. A. Trussler, Duncan Austin, Thomas Harvey, Leonardo Ferreira, Joseph Caruana, Katherine Ormerod, Ignas Juodžbalis
arxiv-2309-06932.description: Abstract We present the analysis of the stellar population and star formation history of 181 MIRI selected galaxies at redshift 0 − 3.5 0-3.5 in the massive galaxy cluster field SMACS J0723.3–7327, commonly referred to as SMACS0723, using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) Mid-Infrared Instrument (MIRI).

arxiv-2310-08226.title: Evaluate PAC codes via Efficient Estimation on Weight Distribution
arxiv-2310-08226.creator: Junhua You, Shaohua Wu, Yajing Deng and Qinyu Zhang
arxiv-2310-08226.description: Abstract In this letter, we introduce an efficient method for estimating weight distributions of polar codes and polarization-adjusted convolutional (PAC) codes. Based on a recursive algorithm of computing the weight enumerating functions of polar cosets, this method focuses on two key objectives: accurately determining the number of low-weight codewords and quickly approximating the distribution of high-weight codewords.

arxiv-2311-11812.title: Improving Real Estate Appraisal with POI Integration and Areal Embedding Preprint
arxiv-2311-11812.creator: Sumin Han, Youngjun Park, Sonia Sabir, Jisun An, Dongman Lee
arxiv-2311-11812.description: Abstract Despite advancements in real estate appraisal methods, this study primarily focuses on two pivotal challenges. Firstly, we explore the often-underestimated impact of Points of Interest (POI) on property values, emphasizing the necessity for a comprehensive, data-driven approach to feature selection. Secondly, we integrate road-network-based Areal Embedding to enhance spatial understanding for real estate appraisal.

arxiv-2402-14997.description: Abstract . For a given unitary operator U U on a separable complex Hilbert space ℋ \mathcal{H} , we describe the set 𝒞 c ​ ( U ) \mathscr{C}_{c}(U) of all conjugations C C (antilinear, isometric, and involutive maps) on ℋ \mathcal{H} for which C ​ U ​ C = U CUC=U .

arxiv-2403-03354.title: Bergman spaces for the bicomplex Vekua equation with bounded coefficients
arxiv-2403-03354.creator: Víctor A. Vicente-Benítez
arxiv-2403-03354.description: Abstract We develop the theory for the Bergman spaces of generalized L p L_{p} -solutions of the bicomplex-Vekua equation ∂ ¯ ​ W = a ​ W + b ​ W ¯ \overline{\boldsymbol{\partial}}W=aW+b\overline{W} on bounded domains, where the coefficients a a and b b are bounded bicomplex-valued functions.

arxiv-2407-00320.title: LiteSearch : Efficacious Tree Search for LLM
arxiv-2407-00320.creator: Ante Wang, Linfeng Song, Ye Tian, Baolin Peng, Dian Yu, Haitao Mi, Jinsong Su, Dong Yu
arxiv-2407-00320.description: Abstract Recent research suggests that tree search algorithms (e.g. Monte Carlo Tree Search) can dramatically boost LLM performance on complex mathematical reasoning tasks. However, they often require more than 10 times the computational resources of greedy decoding due to wasteful search strategies, making them difficult to be deployed in practical applications.

arxiv-2409-12318.title: A large-scale study of performance and equity of commercial remote identity verification technologies across demographics
arxiv-2409-12318.creator: Kaniz Fatima, Michael Schuckers, Gerardo Cruz-Ortiz, Daqing Hou, Sandip Purnapatra, Tiffany Andrews, Ambuj Neupane, Brandeis Marshall, Stephanie Schuckers
arxiv-2409-12318.description: Abstract As more types of transactions move online, there is an increasing need to verify someone’s identity remotely. Remote identity verification (RIdV) technologies have emerged to fill this need. RIdV solutions typically use a smart device to validate an identity document like a driver’s license by comparing a face selfie to the face photo on the document.

arxiv-2510-04192.title: Cooperative Flexibility Exchange: Fair and Comfort-Aware Decentralized Resource Allocation
arxiv-2510-04192.creator: Rabiya Khalid, Evangelos PournarasSchool of Computer Science, University of Leeds, Leeds, United Kingdom, Email: {r.khalid, e.pournaras}@leeds.ac.uk
arxiv-2510-04192.description: Abstract The growing electricity demand and increased use of smart appliances are placing new pressures on power grids, making efficient energy management more important than ever. The existing energy management systems often prioritize system efficiency (balanced energy demand and supply) at the expense of user comfort.

arxiv-2602-21285.title: Asymptotically (un)safe scattering amplitudes from scratch: a deep dive into the IR jungle
arxiv-2602-21285.creator: Benjamin Knorr
arxiv-2602-21285.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Benjamin Knorr. We compute leading order quantum gravity contributions to a simple scalar scattering amplitude in Asymptotic Safety. Our model admits an analytic treatment so that several subtleties can be analysed. We find that (i) the existence of an asymptotically safe renormalisation group fixed point alone does not imply the boundedness of scattering amplitudes, (ii) gravitational logarithms can dominate the infrared regime of massless theories, (iii) a derivative expansion of the effective action fails quantitatively to predict the correct Wilson coefficients in massless theories,

arxiv-2606-08550.title: Dimensionality-Driven Charge Stabilization of Group-IV Color Centers in Diamond Ultrathin Films
arxiv-2606-08550.creator: Jijun Huang, Bing Huang, Song Li

pmc-10616076.title: Cytotoxicity, mutagenicity and genotoxicity of electronic cigarettes emission aerosols compared to cigarette smoke: the REPLICA project
pmc-10616076.creator: Rosalia Emma, Virginia Fuochi, Alfio Distefano, Konstantinos Partsinevelos, Sonja Rust, Fahad Zadjali, Mohammed Al Tobi, Razan Zadjali, Zaina Alharthi, Roberta Pulvirenti, Pio Maria Furneri, Riccardo Polosa, Ang Sun, Massimo Caruso, Giovanni Li Volti, the Replica Project Group
pmc-10616076.description: Concerns have recently increased that the integrity of some scientific research is questionable due to the inability to reproduce the claimed results of some experiments and thereby confirm that the original researcher's conclusions were justified. This phenomenon has been described as 'reproducibility crisis' and affects various fields from medicine to basic applied sciences.

pmc-11477386.title: Transcriptomic Analysis of Genes Associated with Stinger Development at Different Life Stages of Apis mellifera
pmc-11477386.creator: Shiwen Zhou, Juan Zhang, Zhenhui Yang, Yunxi Fu, Yu Lai, Xueling Xu, Ruixin Xu, Yang Lü, Zhiguo Li, Ping Zhao, Songkun Su, Hongyi Nie
pmc-11477386.description: Stingers, evolved from ovipositors, are an important defense organ for the Apidae, Vespidae, and Formicidae species. However, the molecular mechanism of stinger development remains unclear. Here, we show that the earliest time point for the appearance of stingers in Apis mellifera is at the 1-day-old worker pupal stage based on morphological observations and anatomy from the pre-pupal to adult stages.

pmc-11485358.title: Four-dimensional automated quantitative echocardiography assessment of right heart remodeling in patients with functional tricuspid regurgitation
pmc-11485358.creator: Yongzhi Cai, Xiaofeng Zhang, Tongtong Huang, Xiaoju Luo, Decai Zeng, Shuai Chang, Liuliu Huang, Yue Li, Ji Wu
pmc-11485358.description: BackgroundFunctional tricuspid regurgitation (FTR) has a pathophysiological connection with right heart remodeling. Given the increasing focus on right atrial remodeling in recent years, a comprehensive study of all aspects of right heart remodeling is crucial for understanding the progression and treatment of FTR.

pmc-11648247.title: Lipotoxicity of palmitic acid is associated with DGAT1 downregulation and abolished by PPARα activation in liver cells
pmc-11648247.creator: Camilla Moliterni, Francesco Vari, Emily Schifano, Stefano Tacconi, Eleonora Stanca, Marzia Friuli, Serena Longo, Maria Conte, Stefano Salvioli, Davide Gnocchi, Antonio Mazzocca, Daniela Uccelletti, Daniele Vergara, Luciana Dini, Anna Maria Giudetti
pmc-11648247.description: Lipotoxicity refers to the harmful effects of excess fatty acids on metabolic health, and it can vary depending on the type of fatty acids involved. Saturated and unsaturated fatty acids exhibit distinct effects, though the precise mechanisms behind these differences remain unclear.

pmc-11662207.title: ﻿Annotated checklist of Sarcophagidae (Diptera) of Jamaica, with new records
pmc-11662207.creator: Latoya Foote-Gordon, Eric Garraway, Thomas Pape, Eliana Buenaventura
pmc-11662207.description: ﻿AbstractAn annotated checklist of the Sarcophagidae of Jamaica is presented based on material collected from 2018 to 2024, supplemented with specimens in museum collections as well as literature records. The checklist comprises 45 species from 21 genera, of which 23 species from 15 genera were collected during the present study and identified based on male terminalia.

pmc-11675966.title: 26 Years of Skin Banking in Finland
pmc-11675966.creator: Kaarle Antila, Jyrki Vuola, Andrew Lindford
pmc-11675966.description: Autologous skin grafts are the gold standard for definitive wound coverage in burn care, but allograft skin grafts are essential for providing temporary coverage in cases of extensive burns. The Helsinki Skin Bank, established in 1995 at the Helsinki Burn Centre, is Finland’s only licensed skin bank, serving a population of 5.5 million.

pmc-11693232.title: SUPPORTING AGING THROUGH HOUSING CHOICE: A DISCUSSION TOOL FOR COLLABORATION TOWARD LOCAL SOLUTIONS
pmc-11693232.creator: Nancy Berlinger
pmc-11693232.description: This abstract concerns applied research and new open-access publications that will include piloting data from late September 2024, hence its submission as late-breaking research. This paper will present a discussion tool to support local discussion and collaboration to meet the housing needs of moderate-income older Americans.

pmc-11713257.title: Detecting short‐interval longitudinal cortical atrophy in neurodegenerative dementias via cluster scanning: A proof of concept
pmc-11713257.creator: Yuta Katsumi, Michael Brickhouse, Lindsay C. Hanford, Jared A. Nielsen, Maxwell L. Elliott, Ross W. Mair, Alexandra Touroutoglou, Mark C. Eldaief, Randy L. Buckner, Bradford C. Dickerson
pmc-11713257.description: BackgroundRegional brain atrophy estimated from structural MRI is the most widely used measure of neurodegeneration in Alzheimer’s disease (AD), Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration (FTLD), and other dementias. Yet, traditional MRI‐derived morphometric estimates are susceptible to measurement errors, posing a challenge for reliably detecting longitudinal atrophy, particularly over short intervals.

pmc-12642242.title: Development of a novel nomogram to predict the prognosis of acute pancreatitis in pregnancy
pmc-12642242.creator: Xinze Qiu, Baiyuan Zhang, Siwei He, Fu Huang, Ni Chen, Shengmei Liang, Liye Zhu, Mengbin Qin, Zhihai Liang, Jiean Huang, Shiquan Liu
pmc-12642242.description: BackgroundAcute pancreatitis is a rare but serious complication for pregnant women. Early identification of severity of acute pancreatitis in pregnancy (APIP) is of great significance to the treatment. The aim of this study was to investigate the risk factors and develop a novel model for predicting the prognosis of APIP patients.

pmc-12652377.title: Special Issue “The Role of Carotenoids in Health and Disease”
pmc-12652377.creator: Nikolay E. Polyakov, Lowell D. Kispert
pmc-12652377.description: uman health, the biological significance of carotenoids, which must be acquired through the diet, has expanded far beyond their initial recognition. This Special Issue, entitled “The Role of Carotenoids in Health and Disease,” features a collection of articles that describe cutting-edge research and emerging developments in this field.

pmc-12722540.title: Risk factors for coagulase-negative staphylococcal surgical site infections
pmc-12722540.creator: Cynthia T. Nguyen, Amanda M. Brown, Alison K. Lew, Natasha N. Pettit, Rachel Baccile
pmc-12722540.description: We sought to identify risk factors for coagulase-negative staphylococcal (CoNS) surgical site infection (SSI). Risk factors associated with an increased risk of CoNS SSI include male sex and asthma or COPD. Colon surgery was associated with a reduced risk of CoNS SSI.

pmc-12923178.title: The Context of COVID-19 at 18 Months in Relation to Depression, Anxiety, Insomnia: The Emerging Role of Post COVID-19 Symptoms
pmc-12923178.creator: Karin C. Brocki, Monica Buhrman, Farzaneh Badinlou, Lance M. McCracken
pmc-12923178.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic naturally raised concerns about mental health and wellbeing around the world. As time passed, persisting physical and mental symptoms of post COVID-19, referred to as Post COVID Condition (PCC), have become an increasing concern.

pmc-13256505.title: Sex Hormone-Binding Globulin Prevents Carbon Tetrachloride-Induced Liver Fibrosis Development
pmc-13256505.creator: Anna Álvarez-Guaita, Laura Briansó-Llort, Julia Cabrera-Serra, Lidia Fuertes-Rioja, Lorena Ramos-Pérez, María Teresa Salcedo-Allende, Cristina Hernández, Rafael Simó, David M. Selva
pmc-13256505.description: Circulating sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG) concentrations are lower in individuals with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), reflecting its potential role in metabolic liver dysfunction. Our prior studies demonstrated that SHBG can attenuate MASLD by limiting hepatic lipid deposition, partly through suppression of lipogenic pathways, in both cellular and animal models.

pmc-13298370.title: Towards a Mathematical Structure of Global Phenomenal Consciousness
pmc-13298370.creator: Zoe Lee-Youngzie, Naotsugu Tsuchiya, Michael Robinson, Donna Dietz, Martin M. Monti
pmc-13298370.description: Recent work in the structural approach to consciousness has shown great promise as a research paradigm for the formal and empirical study of the phenomenal qualities of experience, i.e., qualia. In this paradigm, qualia are characterized by modeling the internal organization of parts within an experience, or by modeling external relations between instances of experience.

pmc-13386613.title: The lesser trochanter index: detection of increased femoral version in patients with symptomatic hip disease
pmc-13386613.creator: Klaudia Kaczmarek, Andreas Nitsch, Feras Kasabji, Georgi I Wassilew, Jens Goronzy, Maximilian Fischer
pmc-13386613.description: BackgroundFemoral version (FV) affects hip biomechanics and postoperative outcomes in developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) as well as femoroacetabular impingement (FAI). However, its assessment depends on advanced imaging modalities such as CT and MRI with limited clinical utility for cost-effective screening of FV.

pmc-13469589.creator: Huanjie Zhang, Yang Chen, Shenghao Chen, Zilong Zhao, Dexin Zhu

uslaw-usc-t42-s11049.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s11049.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 116 (Emergency Planning And Community Right-To-Know); Subchapter III (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For purposes of this chapter— (1) Administrator The term “Administrator” means the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency. (2) Environment The term “environment” includes water, air, and land and the interrelationship which exists among and between.
